metadata.description: AI agent skills and plugins from the ianlee74/ai-agents repository.

plugins.name: agent-productivity
plugins.description: Skills that build other skills, for any agent harness. Includes factory-creator, which turns a desired outcome into a shareable, self-improving set of skills built on the director pattern (with adapters for Claude Code and a portable Agent Skills bundle), and factory-creator-learn, which improves factory-creator from experience.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Skills for the software development lifecycle. Includes ship, which closes out a coding session: commit, push, open a PR, merge, clean up the branch and worktree, and archive the session, without ever pushing new work onto an already-merged PR.
